lines.text: Do you know why people are using Orbi Transfer?
Your buddy just hit a new record on the bench press. And you filmed the whole thing.
Now he wants that video. Right now.
But you're on different phones, and you don't even have his number.
So you open Orbi Transfer, and hit send.
And it pops up on his phone. Instantly.
But how does it know he's right there?
Your phone works out its rough area. A cell about forty kilometres wide. The gym, and the streets around it.
Everyone in that cell, and the cells around it, shares one live sky.
So the second you hit send, it lands on the screens nearby.
But before it leaves your phone, it gets locked.
Only scrambled bytes travel. Even the server can't watch the lift.
And thirty minutes later, it burns up. No account. No trace.
Orbi Transfer dot com. Try it at your next workout.
